thread:
deploybot: Emergency hold placed on release r-2026.06.21 (slot 42). Reason: control-plane CPU spike detected in eu-west-1. Auto-pin to previous stable (v2.4.1) enabled. Hold requires manual resume.

maya: tagging @ops for visibility. ops, can you confirm whether this is infrastructure-only or a release regression?

ops: looking now. spike originated around 11:22 UTC on control-plane-3 during kvcache rebalance. No customer 5xxs reported so far, some slow tails on p95. Running preflight validations (health checks + perf smoke). ETA ~10-12m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jamie: if preflight fails we should prefer a soft rollback path: route traffic back to v2.4.1 and keep canaries at 0% until we investigate. Avoid full DB migrations in the rollback window.

ricardo: attaching short log tail — seeing repeated OOMs on model-host-13 around the spike: 
```
[2026-06-21T11:22:14Z] ERROR model-host-13 kernel: Alloc failed: OutOfMemory (requested 1.2G)
[2026-06-21T11:22:15Z] WARN kvcache: eviction thrash detected
```
This looks environment-related but could interact with the new runtime changes.

lily: quick note on rollout notes: I've drafted a snippet that pins the rollout to v2.4.1 for customers in EU regions and marks the canary as quarantined. Will push to the release calendar once we decide.

ops: preflight result: health checks passed for control-plane pods (no 5xx), but p95 latency increased ~220ms vs baseline. Given repeated OOMs on a model host, recommending hold + controlled rollback for EU region.

maya: consensus check — apply soft rollback to EU only, pin EU route to v2.4.1, leave other regions on hold but not rolled back. Ops to execute rollback runbook A, eng to start a focused investigation on kvcache rebalance interaction.

jamie: ack. I'll open a short incident channel for the investigation and assign an engineer to the kvcache path.

ops: initiating soft rollback for eu-west-1 now. Steps: 1) scale down canary weight, 2) update route table to v2.4.1, 3) monitor for regressions. I'll post updates. :ok_hand:

deploybot: Action taken: EU route updated to v2.4.1. Canary weight set to 0. Auto-pin remains until manual unpin.

maya: thanks. lily — update the release notes and the calendar entry to show the emergency hold and the EU soft rollback. Also add a Post-Referral item to the release checklist: "validate kvcache rebalance under load".

lily: done — note added, calendar updated, and draft release note saved under /releases/drafts/r-2026.06.21.md.

ricardo: starting reproducer on staging to stress kvcache rebalance, will share results in incident channel in ~30m.

maya: closing coordination here — ops will confirm when it's safe to resume. If preflight clears and no additional OOMs appear, we'll schedule a constrained requeue window with extra health checks.

ops: update at 11:48 UTC: metrics trending down, no new OOMs after rollback. Recommend keep hold active for +1 hour for observation before any requeue.

jamie: noted. I'll add a reversible canary plan for the requeue: gradual weights (1,5,15%) with automated rollback if p95 > baseline +200ms.

maya: agreed. followup: create a short postmortem if this requeue doesn't go cleanly. Thanks everyone. :v:
